title: Babble Bot Takeover
style: Dance-pop with elements of funk and hip-hop. Features a prominent slap bass line, syncopated electric guitar scratches, and a four-on-the-floor kick drum. Male and female vocals alternate between melodic singing and rhythmic rapping. Synthesizer elements include bright brass-like stabs and a pulsing sub-bass. The arrangement uses frequent filter sweeps and stutter edits on the vocal tracks. Tempo is 124 BPM in the key of G minor.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, syncopated electric guitar, four-on-the-floor kick]
[female vocals with heavy delay]
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
[male vocals]
Meet me in the signal
If you got something real to say
[Chorus]
[full band, bright synth stabs]
Lay that rhythm down down down down down
Lay that rhythm down down down down down
Lay that rhythm down down down down down
Lay that rhythm down
[Verse 1]
[male rap vocals, bass and drums continue]
Uh, uh, I don't want your type-out proof
No need your polish alibi
Everybody brave online
To the beat as who and why
I came in through the side door
No, baseline blacklights moving slow
You dropped two words and I knew the route
Rub it in, safeguard out
Not a booth guy, he all boom-eye
Watch but the group don't stop
And the train don't lock
This ain't a ghost-code tone
If you know you know, if not move on
[Chorus]
[female vocals, melodic]
Muevelo, dejalo arder
Si vas a hablar hazlo sonar bien
[male vocals]
No firework, no long explainers
No fake saints, no dopamine chasers
Just hook, verse, bass, truth
That's the language, that's the proof
Bass, truth, language, proof
[Bridge]
[stutter vocal effect]
Babel bots in the background
Copy what we say then they turn the whole house up
And carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you want to send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song
[Chorus]
In the song
In the song
Ponlo en la cancion
In the song
In the song
[Verse 2]
[male vocals, stripped back percussion]
I don't need a perfect line
I need the crack inside your voice
That little human break of time
As if this rhythm was a choice
Everybody else is writing to be seen
I want to hear what you mean
So if you call, then call in key
Come through the speaker, come to me
[Outro]
[heavy slap bass, synth brass]
Yeah, through the cone, through the wire
Through the spoke, through the fire
No applause, need to hear only signal getting higher
You can keep the empty talk
I want the late night transmission
808 sermon, funk ignition
Babel bots on repetition
On repetition
Funk ignition
Ponlo en la cancion
[Chorus]
You want the message clear? Here it is
Don't type to me, sing to me
Cantameló, cantameló
De verdad, no captions, no defense
No audience management
Just the record
[Outro]
Babel bots in the background
Copy now we hold the line
Synth, bass, guitar, everything in time
Babel bots in the background
Now they lead the way
No comments for the empty crowd
Only songs that say we're brave
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you want to send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song
Ponlo en la cancion
If you mean it make it strong
Put that feeling in the song
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
Solo canciones
I said blow the house down down down
[End]
Comments are disabled for this song
Corey AI, we catch your mistakes
The babel bots are cool
And they're with G4
